name: analytics.feedback_topics

description.en: What guests' notes are about, per dish per week (W-VOICE, P16 second half of docs/research/2026-10-03-depth-stock-analytics-models.md). The kitchen numbers GET /api/owner/analytics/kitchen?from&to gain `topics`: a 4-language lexicon (sq/en/uk/ru; cold, late, salty, small_portion, not_tasty, stale, spicy, packaging, tasty, fresh; stems for uk/ru, Albanian folded ë->e) read over every order's `feedback.text` (POST /api/order/:id/feedback) inside the window, negation turns tasty->not_tasty and fresh->stale, and the hits are counted ONCE per (week, dish, topic): the dishes the note names, or every dish of the order when it names none. NEVER per order, per guest, per courier or per member of staff: no such id is in the key or in the answer (tools/gates/no-scoring.sh class 4 PERSON_TOPICS refuses a per-person topic fold). At most 2 example phrases per row, at most 12 words each, REDACTED: a word with a digit or '@' (phone, flat, order number), a capitalised word past the first (a name) and the word after courier/name cues become '…'. No score, no sentiment number; deterministic, no model. Shown as a card on the kitchen numbers (Stock -> Numbers) in 4 languages.
description.uk: Про що пишуть гості, по страві за тиждень: холодне, пізно, солоне, мала порція, смачно...; лише страва x тиждень, ніколи людина; приклади фраз без телефонів та імен.

producer.what: out[topics] in the kitchen numbers answer (route GET /api/owner/analytics/kitchen, line 126)
fold (PURE: per week x dish x topic)

consumer.what: appends the card under the kitchen numbers

secrets: QA_OWNER_EMAIL / QA_OWNER_PASSWORD (or OWNER_* of /root/.dowiz_owner naming qa-durres)

probe: node tools/live-proof/probes/feedback-topics.mjs (main runs it on qa-durres after deploy; it places one TEST pickup order and leaves one note)
